scope_rule: All retained records keep exact condition and site; inference uses the following declared scopes without semantic grouping
scenario_rule: inventory every resolved genus/family; run the ten largest per rank by propagated full non-MediaDive contribution count plus the four predicted genera and their resolved families, each requiring three supporting studies; ties by taxon ID; no effect or significance selection
ora: no_native_rerun; export separately labeled fixed_baseline and recomputed_remaining count backgrounds for Ilyas
weighting: equal experiments within study, equal eligible studies
uncertainty: conditional 95% Student t interval on study means; exact binomial interval on directional share; no full-pipeline error-rate guarantee (#182)
families: six directional trait tests BH and fifteen directional log-ratio tests BY, separately per scenario/scope/population/representation
zero_rule: shared fractions require both full totals positive; log ratios additionally require all four numerator/denominator trait counts positive; no pseudocount
higher_rank_rule: retain and flag direct source assertions above excluded lineage; remove known lineage sources even when rolled into higher-rank reported taxa
